product_metadata.title: Arlee Non-Skid Memory Foam Chair Pads, 2 Count (Pack of 1), Bamboo Tan
features: Cover: 100% Polyester - Fill: 100% Premium Grade Memory Foam

High-quality Memory Foam For Total Comfort & Added Support: Arlee Home Fashions soft and comfortable memory foam seat cushions are filled with premium grade memory foam that helps reduce pressure on hips, tailbone, & lower back. The soft pads evenly distribute weight to relieve minor aches & pain.
Microdot Non-Skid Backing: The chair cushions have microdot skid-resistant backing to secure the cushions firmly to the chair for perfect placement.

Long Lasting Chair Pads: Arlee seat cushions are uniquely designed and fully tufted to prevent lumping. This makes the cushions bouncy and fuller for a longer period. Perfect to use with office chairs, kitchen chairs, and patio chairs and can even be used as floor cushions.

Easy to Clean: These restful and snug cushions can be spot cleaned, or hand washed with mild detergent and cool water. The chair pad should be thoroughly dry before placing it on your favorite chair! Our fashionable seat cushions measure 15.5” x 15.5” each and come in different colors.

LET IT BREATH: It takes 4-6 hours for the memory foam to expand 90% and it could take another 4-6 hours to get close to full expansion, especially if it's cold outside – memory foam likes warm, indoor temperatures. It is recommended to wait 24 hours before sitting on it, but don’t worry if you can’t. The memory foam softens during this time at which point the item is no longer firm or uncomfortable to sit on.
